# Richard Honeycombe

Richard Honeycombe is the current Connétable of [St Ouen](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Richard Honeycombe has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-honeycombe#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St Ouen.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/richard-honeycombe/)

Richard Honeycombe has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Ouen](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen). \[[stouen.je](https://stouen.je/wp-content/uploads/sites/10/2026/04/20260401-Message-From-the-Connetable.pdf)\]
